name: obol
description: Deterministic, zero-token Claude Code token-usage analyzer — measured cache savings and concrete ways to spend less.
long_description: Obol reads your local Claude Code logs and runs the exact same deterministic math as the Obol CLI and VS Code extension — no LLM, no network, nothing sent anywhere, zero tokens spent. It reports the money prompt caching has already saved you (measured, not estimated), grades your efficiency, and lists concrete, confidence-rated opportunities to spend less. Ask Claude to "analyze my token usage" and the report appears right in the conversation.

tools.name: analyze_token_usage
tools.description: Analyze Claude Code token usage and return a deterministic, zero-token report: measured cache savings, efficiency grade, and concrete money-saving opportunities.
